Name: bandit_ambush
name: Bandits in Ambush
description: Men rise out of a ditch or a ruin with clubs and sickles and demand what you carry.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); mechanics.md row 11 (drought raiders); row 36 (journeys)

Name: raider_patrol
name: A Raider Patrol
description: Riders on the skyline, then the thud of hooves: a patrol of raiders looking for herds and stragglers.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.1;§4.3; notes L15;L20-21

Name: eastern_refugees
name: Refugees from the East
description: A column of households on foot with what they could carry, fleeing the raids in the east; they ask for water, bread and the way to the gate.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); events.csv eastern_refugees_at_the_gates; wb §4.1 (migrations into the Empire); notes L15

Name: caravan_merchants
name: Travelling Merchants
description: A small merchant party with pack donkeys and hired guards, glad of news of the road and willing to trade.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); mechanics.md row 8 (caravans); wb §5 (the City of the Moon: hub of trade)

Name: lion_in_the_reeds
name: A Lion in the Reeds
description: A lion that hunts the reed beds at dusk; kings hunt its kind for glory, travellers only try to live.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); A: the Mesopotamian lion of the river reed-beds and the royal lion hunt

Name: wolf_pack
name: A Wolf Pack
description: Lean wolves driven down from the steppe by hunger, trailing anything that walks alone at night.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); A: the steppe wolf of ancient Mesopotamia

Name: wild_boar
name: A Wild Boar
description: A marsh boar rooting in the barley or the reed-edge, fast and short-tempered.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); A: wild boar of the southern Mesopotamian marshes

Name: venomous_snake
name: A Venomous Snake
description: A viper in the heat of the day, under a stone or in a crack of the old brick.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); A: desert vipers of the Near East

Name: jackal_pack
name: A Jackal Pack
description: Jackals that dig at the old graves and circle a lone traveller; the city carves dogs on its doors against what walks with them.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §5 (dog and owl engravings ward houses against evil spirits); A: the golden jackal
